modelOverview: The Rolex Submariner is the archetypal dive watch, introduced in 1953 and waterproof to 300 metres. The no-date Submariner keeps the purist symmetry of a clean dial without a date aperture, pairing a rotating Cerachrom bezel with high-legibility Chromalight markers. It remains one of the most recognisable and enduring tool watches ever made.

124060.bezel: Unidirectional rotatable 60-minute graduated bezel with black Cerachrom ceramic insert and platinum-coated numerals
124060.dial: Black dial with Chromalight luminescent hour markers and hands
124060.description: The Submariner 124060 is the current-generation no-date Submariner, enlarged to a 41mm Oystersteel case and driven by the Calibre 3230 with roughly 70 hours of power reserve. Its symmetrical black dial free of a date window and matte black Cerachrom bezel make it the purist's diver. Every example is sourced and authenticated before sale.
